1.name: The Creative
1.body: The pure creative force expressed through your unique role. Brings inspiration into form.

2.name: The Receptive
2.body: Direction held in stillness. Knows where to go without forcing.

3.name: Ordering
3.body: Mutation in the early stage of a cycle. Patience with what's not yet ordered.

4.name: Youthful Folly
4.body: Mental answers to questions — but the answer is always provisional until experience tests it.

5.name: Waiting
5.body: The rhythms of life — eating, sleeping, working in a pattern that flows with timing.

6.name: Conflict
6.body: The emotional bandwidth that controls intimacy. The barrier that opens and closes.

7.name: The Army
7.keynote: Role of the Self in Interaction
7.body: Leadership through the recognized self. The one chosen to guide.

8.name: Holding Together
8.body: Individual creative expression contributing to the collective.

9.name: Focus
9.body: Concentrated focus on what matters. Filters out the irrelevant.

10.name: Treading
10.body: Love of self — how you behave when no one's watching.

11.name: Peace
11.body: A still room of ideas — the mind as a peaceful place where concepts gather.

12.name: Standstill
12.body: The voice that knows when to wait and when to speak. Mood-driven articulation.

13.name: The Fellowship of Man
13.body: Listening to others' stories — the witness who holds memory.

14.name: Possession in Great Measure
14.body: Skills with resources — material abundance through aligned work.

15.name: Modesty
15.body: The rhythm of humanity — accepts all rhythms, no judgment about pace.

16.name: Enthusiasm
16.body: Selective enthusiasm — talent honed over time becomes expression.

17.name: Following
17.body: Logical opinions about how to organize. Mental clarity on patterns.

18.name: Work on the Decayed
18.body: Sees what's not working and has the energy to correct it. The natural critic.

19.name: Approach
19.body: Sensitivity to the tribe — knows when food, shelter, or affection is needed.

20.name: Contemplation
20.body: Aware speech in the present moment. "I am, here, now."

21.name: Biting Through
21.body: Control over material resources — the manager who needs autonomy.

22.name: Grace
22.body: Emotional charm — moments of social grace when the mood lands.

23.name: Splitting Apart
23.body: Translating individual insight into language the collective can use.

24.name: Returning
24.body: Mental review — finding the answer by going over the question again.

25.name: Innocence
25.body: Universal love — the higher self that loves without condition.

26.name: The Taming Power of the Great
26.body: Will applied to manifestation — the trickster who can sell anything.

27.name: Nourishment
27.body: Caretaking — instinctively wanting to feed and protect the young.

28.name: The Preponderance of the Great
28.body: Risk and struggle for what's meaningful. The player who finds purpose in resistance.

29.name: The Abysmal
29.body: Commitment of the body — saying yes and following through with energy.

30.name: The Clinging Fire
30.body: Desire and fantasy — the imagined future emotional experience.

31.name: Influence
31.body: Democratic leadership — leads by being elected, not by self-appointing.

32.name: Duration
32.body: Sensing what will last — instinctive evaluation of long-term viability.

33.name: Retreat
33.body: Strategic withdrawal — telling stories of what's been seen, then stepping back.

34.name: The Power of the Great
34.body: Raw individual power — the busy one whose energy is felt.

35.name: Progress
35.body: Hunger for new experience — moving through phases of life looking for what's next.

36.name: The Darkening of the Light
36.body: Emotional crisis as a step toward growth. The naïve excitement that leads to expansion.

37.name: The Family
37.body: Tribal bonding — agreements, hugs, the warmth of those who belong.

38.name: Opposition
38.body: Spirit of struggle — knowing what's worth fighting for.

39.name: Obstruction
39.body: Provoking spirit — testing others to see who has the will to engage.

40.name: Deliverance
40.body: Going it alone for the community — knows when to break from the tribe to bring something back.

41.name: Decrease
41.body: Fantasy of new experience — the starting pressure of every emotional cycle.

42.name: Increase
42.body: Closing cycles — the body finishing what was started so the next can begin.

43.name: Break-through
43.body: Individual knowing — the "aha" that arrives whole, before language catches up.

44.name: Coming to Meet
44.body: Recognizing patterns from the past — wariness from lived experience.

45.name: The Gathering Together
45.body: Material leadership — gathering the tribe around resources.

46.name: Pushing Upward
46.body: Love of the body — the body that knows it's in the right place at the right time.

47.name: Oppression
47.body: Mental confusion until insight comes through — the way of "figuring it out."

48.name: The Well
48.body: The depth of skill — the talent that's been there since the beginning, refined by use.

49.name: Revolution
49.body: Sensing principle violations — the line that triggers revolution.

50.name: The Cauldron
50.body: The values that hold the tribe together — taboos, ethics, codes of conduct.

51.name: The Arousing
51.body: The shock that wakes others up — competition that ascends to spiritual.

52.name: Keeping Still
52.body: Stillness with focus — the pressure that contains energy until it's directed.

53.name: Development
53.body: Opening new cycles — the pressure to start something.

54.name: The Marrying Maiden
54.body: Drive to rise — ambition with material transformation in view.

55.name: Abundance
55.body: Emotional abundance — the wave of feeling that's about meaning itself.

56.name: The Wanderer
56.body: The storyteller — bringing experiences back as story for others to live through.

57.name: The Gentle
57.body: Clarity in the moment — splenic insight that arrives once and quietly.

58.name: The Joyous
58.body: Aliveness — the pressure to challenge what's not working.

59.name: Dispersion
59.body: The bond-breaker — penetrating defenses to create intimacy.

60.name: Limitation
60.body: Accepting limitation as the seed of mutation — what's contained finds new form.

61.name: Inner Truth
61.body: Pressure to know the unknowable — the inspiration that drives mental movement.

62.name: Preponderance of the Small
62.body: Detail-oriented voice — names and facts that make the abstract concrete.

63.name: After Completion
63.body: Mental pressure to question what's just been resolved. The healthy skepticism.

64.name: Before Completion
64.body: Mental pressure of unresolved questions — confusion until clarity comes through reflection.
